payload.details:
T-0003 showed AGENT_RESUMED events that went pi-orca-deepseek -> opencode-strongest -> hermes-oneshot with mode="new" and model="". A fresh session was started (correct behaviour), but the event name AGENT_RESUMED implies a live model swap (incorrect label).

The fix is in src/fleet/dispatcher.py, method Dispatcher._restart_on, around the kernel.record_event call for AGENT_RESUMED, to name the event AGENT_RESTARTED when mode is "new" and keep AGENT_RESUMED when mode is "resume".

Exact diff:

--- a/src/fleet/dispatcher.py
+++ b/src/fleet/dispatcher.py
@@ _restart_on (Dispatcher) @@
         self.kernel.record_event(
-            "AGENT_RESUMED", subject=run.task.id, fence=run.lease.fence,
+            "AGENT_RESTARTED" if mode == "new" else "AGENT_RESUMED",
             subject=run.task.id, fence=run.lease.fence,
             payload={"profile": profile.id, "mode": mode,
                      "model": model or profile.model,
                      "previous_profile": run.lease.holder})
options: apply the diff, then re-run T-0003 and assert no AGENT_RESUMED with mode=new
